summary.text: Chris Lambton is the Democratic candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 1st Barnstable District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He won the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026, defeating Steven Leibowitz, 72.7% to 27.3%, in a race with no incumbent.
